note: SYNTHETIC policy language written for the hackathon demo. Not real State Farm wording. Swap for official sample language if the event provides it. The peril agent cites these clause ids; the adjuster console shows them.

flood_policy.name: Standard Flood Insurance Policy (synthetic)
flood_policy.covers: Direct physical loss by or from flood: a general and temporary condition of partial or complete inundation of normally dry land from surface water.

clauses.FL-COV-1: Damage at or below the established interior waterline caused by inundation is covered.
clauses.FL-COV-2: Building systems submerged by floodwater (water heater, furnace, electrical outlets below the waterline) are covered, including the cost of licensed inspection.
clauses.FL-COV-3: Mold resulting directly from floodwater saturation is covered where remediation begins promptly.
clauses.FL-EXCL-1: Loss caused by wind, wind-driven rain, or water entering through the roof or an opening above the waterline is NOT covered by this policy.
clauses.FL-EXCL-2: Contents loss is covered only under a contents endorsement; otherwise refer to the homeowners policy.

homeowners_policy.name: Homeowners HO-3 (synthetic)
homeowners_policy.covers: Sudden and accidental direct physical loss, including wind and wind-driven rain entering through a wind-created opening.

clauses.HO-COV-1: Damage from wind-driven rain entering through a roof or window opening created by wind is covered.
clauses.HO-COV-2: Personal property (contents) damaged by a covered peril is covered at actual cash value.
clauses.HO-EXCL-3a: Loss caused by flood, surface water, or inundation is EXCLUDED under this policy and must be adjudicated under the flood policy.
clauses.HO-EXCL-3b: Loss caused by continuous or repeated seepage over weeks or months is excluded.

adjudication_rules.rule: Damage with a position height (y) at or below the 0.9 m waterline, in category flood/hazard/contents, is presumed FLOOD and routed to flood_policy under FL-COV-1 or FL-COV-2.

Damage with a position height (y) ABOVE the 0.9 m waterline whose evidence points to roof or window entry is presumed WIND_DRIVEN_RAIN, routed to homeowners_policy under HO-COV-1, and EXCLUDED from the flood policy under FL-EXCL-1. This is the contested wind-vs-water determination.
Structural damage requires a licensed structural engineer assessment before coverage is finalised. Always needs_human.
Any item where the two policies conflict, or where the cause of loss cannot be determined from the manifest alone, is marked needs_human. Agents never resolve a contested peril silently.
No agent may approve payment. Every claim draft leaves this pipeline with status draft_pending_human.
